title: Bike & Roll

services.name: Bike Rentals
services.desc: Bike and Roll’s most popular tour! Enjoy the car-free lakefront trail and explore Chicago’s beaches, parks, lagoons, and gorgeous Lincoln Park Zoo (free admission). This tour offers a diverse mix of nature and attractions. Top sights include The Chicago Lakefront, Navy Pier, North Avenue Beach, Lincoln Park Zoo, and the Conservatory. Easy riding and kid-friendly, great fun for the whole family! (Departs from Navy Pier) All tour prices include bike & helmet. Please arrive 15 minutes before the tour to saddle up.
